references.text: Basic regulations concerning the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים), describing what kind of sacrifice this is and how it should be performed.
Detailed instructions about the peace offering, including how the meat should be handled and who may eat from it.
The first time the same sacrificial formula for a peace offering is mentioned in chapter 7, at Nahshon's offering.
Parallel verse describing the same type of peace offering given by Elizur, son of Shedeur.
First mention of Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, as leader of the tribe of Simeon.
Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, is described as the prince over the army of the sons of Simeon.
Verse introducing Shelumiel's offering on the fifth day.
